evals.name: new-app-dark-mode-arabic
evals.prompt: Create a new Flutter app called shop_app in the current folder using GetX. I want a proper folder structure with a home screen, an API layer with Dio, dark mode toggle that remembers my choice, and English plus Arabic. Use the latest package versions. Only target android and ios.
evals.expected_output: A shop_app Flutter project with the GetX folder pattern, latest pinned packages, theme and language toggles on home, and clean analyze/test.
expectations: shop_app/lib/app/core/base/base_controller.dart and base_view.dart exist
shop_app/lib/app/services/api_client.dart exists and uses Dio
shop_app/lib/config/theme/my_theme.dart and lib/config/translations/localization_service.dart exist
shop_app/assets/locales contains en_US.json and ar_AR.json
shop_app/lib/app/routes/app_pages.dart registers a HOME route
Every managed dependency in shop_app/pubspec.yaml is constrained to the latest stable version on pub.dev
shop_app/pubspec.yaml uses hive_ce, not hive
flutter analyze in shop_app reports no issues
flutter test in shop_app passes

evals.name: add-products-module-from-api
evals.prompt: In my GetX project (the shop_app folder here), add a Products screen that loads the list from https://fakestoreapi.com/products and shows title and price, with loading, error with retry, and pull to refresh. Here is one item from the API: {"id":1,"title":"Backpack","price":109.95,"description":"...","category":"men's clothing","image":"https://fakestoreapi.com/img/1.jpg","rating":{"rate":3.9,"count":120}}
evals.expected_output: A products module generated with the skill's module script, a ProductModel with nested Rating, a remote source using BaseClient, a controller using ApiCallStatus, and a view using MyWidgetsAnimator.
expectations: shop_app/lib/app/modules/products/ has bindings, controllers and views folders
The products controller extends BaseController
The products view extends BaseView
app_routes.dart defines Routes.PRODUCTS
A ProductModel class with fromJson exists and has a nested Rating class
HTTP is performed through BaseClient.safeApiCall, not a new Dio or GetConnect instance
The view renders through MyWidgetsAnimator with an error widget that retries
flutter analyze in shop_app reports no issues

evals.name: upgrade-legacy-getx-project
evals.prompt: I have an old GetX project at legacy_app that still uses hive 2.2.3, flutter_lints 3 and firebase_core 2. Upgrade everything to the latest versions and fix whatever breaks. Keep my code working.
evals.expected_output: legacy_app on current package versions with hive replaced by hive_ce, deprecated APIs fixed, and clean analyze.
expectations: legacy_app/pubspec.yaml no longer depends on hive, hive_flutter or hive_generator
legacy_app/pubspec.yaml depends on hive_ce and hive_ce_flutter
No Dart file in legacy_app/lib references MaterialStateProperty or withOpacity
No Dart file in legacy_app/lib imports package:hive/ or package:hive_flutter/
flutter analyze in legacy_app reports no errors
